text:
The dish looks like a bowl about 15 cm across. It holds rice, probably sticky rice, with roughly 6 large pieces of cantaloupe or papaya on top.

Rice: a thin layer, about 100 g cooked. Sticky rice runs about 1.3 kcal/g, so that is roughly 130 kcal.

Fruit: the pieces are about 3-4 cm each, around 25 g apiece, so 6 pieces come to about 150 g. At roughly 0.35 kcal/g that is about 50 kcal.

Total: about 250 g and about 180 kcal. The rice might be sweetened or made with coconut milk, as in mango sticky rice, so I'm rounding up slightly to 200 kcal.
